_about: Sea step 11 THE CROSSING (LOCKED in diary/DECISIONS_SEA.md: fog-bank handoff, every winning run, sailing back starts a fresh island run, NG+ built now and locked till the Vault). ISLAND SIDE (metres from the archipelago's middle, data/archipelago.json): when the island quest is done (the Warden beaten, the boat built) the G U-boat surfaces at uboat_from and sails slowly to the fog bank at fog_at, where it dives; the fog thickens round the bank within fog_reach m; the boat's middle within fog_radius m of fog_at for cross_after_s = the crossing (the host decides): the run is won for everyone, whoever is aboard comes out of the fog in the sea world. SEA SIDE (sea coordinates): arrive = where the fleet's first ship is laid (bow toward toward), the party on her deck; the sea's fog is x sea_fog_mult for sea_fog_s, easing out; a painted backdrop of the island (game/painting_art.gd island) stands backdrop.at, size m, fading out over fade_s. back = the home fog bank at region 1's south edge: a ship whose deck we stand on within radius m of it takes us back to the islands (Wreck Cay, land_at = metres from its middle), where a fresh run starts. hub_painting = the sea painting in the hub (metres from the hub's middle, yaw degrees), it works once this player has crossed. NG+ (ng): each level adds item_levels to every sea enemy and sea loot (capped at the game's max item level) and luck_per to the gun tier rolls of sea loot; it opens only after the Vault (the hub lectern ng_lectern). ALL NUMBERS MINE.
notice_start: A U-boat surfaces beyond Gull Rock, its checkered G flag snapping. Take the boat and follow it into the fog.
notice_cross: The fog closes round the boat ...
notice_won: The run is won: the U-boat led the way out to sea.

back.notice: The fog thins on a familiar shore: the islands. A new run begins.
